# handoff

Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

Ships in the [`mpocock`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Requirements

Needs write access to a handoffs directory. Run it by hand; the model does not load it.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install mpocock@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add mpocock@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install mpocock@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
